name: Soccer Lab - AI Soccer Coach
subtitle: AI Coach, Drills & Film Review
promotionalText: Train like a pro with your own AI coach: a plan for your position, 150+ drills, AI film review of your clips, food scans and streaks that keep you going.
description:
Soccer Lab is your personal football training app. Tell it your position, level and goals, and it builds a training plan for you, with an AI coach in your pocket to answer questions and keep you improving every week.

YOUR TRAINING PLAN
• A plan built for your position, level and how many days you train
• 150+ drills with animated diagrams: ball mastery, dribbling, passing, finishing, first touch, defending and goalkeeping
• Ready-made sessions and fitness work
• Live Callouts and Cone Reaction: drills that call out moves so you react like in a real match
• Drill Library to find any drill fast

ASK SOCCO, YOUR AI FOOTBALL BUDDY
• Socco, the app's talking football, answers anything about your game, your training or a match coming up
• Answers based on your position, level and this week's training

AI FILM REVIEW
• Pick a clip of yourself training and get feedback on your technique
• Clear things to fix, with drills that help

NUTRITION
• Scan your plate with the camera to see calories and protein
• Meal plans for match day, recovery and training days
• Water tracking and daily targets for your body and goals

STAY MOTIVATED
• Streaks: train 10 minutes and keep the fire going
• Earn XP, climb the ranks and see where you stand on the leaderboard
• Home screen widgets

SOCCER LAB PRO
Soccer Lab Pro unlocks the full app, including the AI features.
• Weekly: $7.99 per week
• Yearly: $39.99 per year
Prices are in US dollars and may differ in other countries. Payment is charged to your Apple ID when you confirm the purchase. The subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it any time in your iPhone's Settings under your name → Subscriptions. 
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://glittery-banoffee-bbbd05.netlify.app/privacy

reviewNotes:
Thanks for reviewing Soccer Lab 2.0 (previously Skiller AI).

Sign-in: the app uses Sign in with Apple only, so no demo account is needed. Accounts can be deleted in the app: Profile → Settings → Delete account.

Subscriptions: Soccer Lab Pro (Weekly $7.99, Yearly $39.99) unlocks the app after onboarding. Please use a Sandbox account to test the purchase. "Restore" is on the plans screen.

Codes on the plans screen:
• "Redeem App Store code" opens Apple's own offer-code sheet.
• "Creator code" is for creator referral codes. A creator code does NOT unlock anything or change the price. It only records which creator recommended the app, so we can pay that creator a share. All purchases go through Apple's in-app purchase.

AI features (AI Coach, AI film review, food scan, AI nutrition plan) use Anthropic's Claude through our own server, with daily limits. Photos and video frames are sent only when the user chooses to scan or review, and are not stored. This is explained in the app and in our privacy policy.

Where to find things: Ask Socco (the AI coach) is on the Home tab; film review is on the Film tab; food scan is on the Nutrition tab; drills are on the Training tab.

Contact: aliazam6068@gmail.com
